mechanism_narrative: A higher level of non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a robust labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months when PAYEMS exceeds the 50th percentile of its 10-year historical distribution.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.5% signals an overheating labor market, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months when UNRATE is below 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.5%) signals aggressive monetary tightening in a tight labor market, compressing earnings growth and increasing risk aversion, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises > 0.25pp in 1 month AND UNRATE < 4.5%
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months when FEDFUNDS rises >0.25pp and UNRATE <4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1200 thousand units signals weakening consumer demand and reduced economic growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion periods, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months when HOUST < 1200.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 110 (index 2017=100) signals a contraction in manufacturing output, reducing corporate profits and increasing recession risk, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months when INDPRO < 110.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) indicates elevated inflation, which typically leads to higher interest rates and reduced equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months when CPIAUCSL is above the 75th percentile of its historical distribution.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in retail sales (RSAFS) above 385,000 million dollars signals robust consumer spending, supporting corporate revenue growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months when RSAFS > 385000.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, a federal funds rate above 4.5% signals the Federal Reserve's commitment to controlling inflation, increasing borrowing costs and reducing corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In monetary tightening cycles, SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%.
